summary: Implement Space Fractions microservices system: gateway (Express, port 3000), game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Keycloak OIDC. Browser UI at /. Full OpenAPI contract, internal.proto, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Jenkinsfile, Terraform, Vault/Istio reference configs.

tasks.description: Create project scaffolding: package.json with npm workspaces, .env.example, .gitignore, shared package with fraction arithmetic and auth middleware
Create SQL migrations: users, questions, games, game_answers tables with indexes and seed data
Implement game-service: create game, get game, pause, resume, submit answer, get score, list games
Implement question-service: get questions, search questions (Elasticsearch), get question by id
Implement user-service: user profile, OIDC callback, token validation helper
Implement admin-service: create question, delete question, update question, list questions with correct answers
Implement gateway: route composition, health check, browser UI serving, OpenAPI spec endpoint, metrics aggregation
Create browser UI: introduction, main menu, play, help, score view, ending feedback, pause/resume controls
Create OpenAPI specification covering all endpoints per contract
Create internal.proto for inter-service gRPC contracts
Create Dockerfiles for gateway and all services
Create Docker Compose with all services, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Keycloak, Prometheus
Create unit tests: fraction arithmetic, auth middleware, game engine, scoring, pause/resume logic
Create integration tests: API contract, authorization, pause/resume flow, scoring idempotency, error cases
Create Kubernetes resources: deployments, services, configmaps, secrets references
Create Jenkinsfile for CI/CD pipeline
Create Terraform AWS reference configuration
Create Vault and Istio reference configurations (syntactically valid, labeled reference-only)
Create traceability.json mapping all requirements, diagrams, and components
Create README.md with setup instructions, URLs, accounts, test commands, and architecture deviations

assumptions: A3: Keycloak realm and users pre-provisioned via realm.json import
A4: Fraction answers are simple fractions 'a/b' where a,b are integers, b≠0
A5: Admin role claim is realm_access.roles containing 'admin'
A6: Game ending triggers after all questions answered
A7: Questions are multiple-choice with 4 options
A8: Elasticsearch indices created at startup
A9: Prometheus metrics on separate port 9090 per service
A10: Node.js 22+ per prompt, overriding Architecture_Documentation.md Node 18-20
A11: SLO is 99.9% (not 99.99%); error budget contradiction resolved in AD-013
conflicts: INPUT-001: Architecture_Documentation.md line 181: 99.99% uptime implies 0.01% error budget, not 1%. Resolved: assume 99.9% SLO.
Architecture_Documentation.md lists 3 components (Game, Question, User) but prompt and ComponentDiagram show 4 (adds Admin). Resolved: implement all 4.
Architecture doc specifies Node 18-20, prompt requires Node 22+. Resolved: use Node 22.
Architecture doc specifies Redis 6-7, ES 7-8, PG 14-15. Prompt is silent on versions. Resolved: use latest stable in ranges (Redis 7, ES 8, PG 16).
Architecture doc shows minimal DB schema (games table only). Prompt requires users, questions, games, answers. Resolved: expand schema.
Architecture doc has /play endpoint. Prompt contract has POST /api/games. Resolved: implement both, /play redirects or proxies.
